ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Five dialysis bags, made from a semipermeable membrane that is impermeable to glucose, were filled with various concentrations of glucose and placed in separate beakers containing 0.5 M glucose solution. The bags were weighed every 10 min, and the percent change in mass for each bag was graphed. Which line on the graph represents the bag that contained a solution isotonic to the 0.5 M glucose solution?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a line graph of “Percentage change in weight” changing with “Time (minutes)”. All five lines start from 0% change in mass: A and B rise with time, D and E fall with time, and C is a horizontal line that remains at 0% change in mass throughout. Reasoning: The question stem states that each dialysis bag is placed in a 0.5 M glucose solution, and asks to find the bag in which the solution inside the bag is isotonic with the 0.5 M glucose solution. Isotonic means that the solute concentrations inside and outside the bag are equal, so there is no net movement of water, and the mass of the dialysis bag will not undergo a net change. The only one in the figure that consistently has no percentage change in mass is horizontal line C, so the answer is C.

Apply the rule that an isotonic bag would have no net water movement and thus no percent change in mass. Select the line with no mass change: C.
